integrity.computational_check: Stand-alone exact rational CTMC first-step Laplace calculations, 6048 assertions, plus positive-time survival diagnostics.
integrity.computational_limit: Finite parameter checks are not a proof of the all-parameter theorem.
integrity.proof_basis: Explicit conditional detection-time mixtures and a strictly positive convolution survival identity.

limitations: Uniform single initial infection and a finite star contact network are assumed.
Independent memoryless oriented transmission clocks, perfect continuous monitoring and no recovery are essential.
No implication is asserted for infection burden before detection, empirical hospital surveillance or general network topology.
Historical novelty has not been independently established.
title: Sharp stochastic-order reversal for SI sentinel placement on a star
